item.title: New car registrations in Donegal jump 35% in November
item.description: Donegal has recorded a sharp rise in the number of private cars licensed for the first time last month, with new figures showing a 35% increase year-on-year. In November 2024, a total of 293 new private cars were licensed locally. That number climbed to 396 in November this year. item.title: Donegal shoppers spend least using bank cards last Christmas
item.description: Donegal shoppers spent the least on card transactions last Christmas, according to data from AIB. The bank analysed customer spending for December 2024 and found that the average card spend in Donegal was €1,642, significantly lower than Wicklow, where shoppers spent €2,022 on average.
